newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador July inflation rose to 2.06 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador July inflation rose to 2.06 pct.

text.p: Ecuadorean consumer price inflation rose to 2.06 percent in July from 1.7 percent in July 1996, the official statistics institute said Thursday.
It was also up from 1.39 percent in June 1997.
Accumulated inflation in the year reached 19.8 percent and over the 12 month period was 31.54 percent.
The biggest rises in July were food and drinks, up 2.71 percent, followed by clothing at 2.15 percent and housing at 2.08 percent.
The government has forecast inflation of about 29 percent this year, up from 25.5 percent in 1996.
